Short title and commencement

ACT III of 1987
ACT III of 1987
ELECTORAL ROLLS (AMENDMENT) ACT 1987
An Act further to amend the Electoral Rolls Act, 1974
[Gazette
of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I , 15th June, 1985]
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Electoral Rolls (Amendment)
Act, 1987.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 6, Act XXI of 1974

ACT III of 1987
ACT III of 1987
ELECTORAL ROLLS (AMENDMENT) ACT 1987
An Act further to amend the Electoral Rolls Act, 1974
[Gazette
of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I , 15th June, 1985]
2. Amendment of section 6, Act
XXI of 1974.--In the Electoral Rolls Act, 1974 (XXI of 1974), in section 6,
in subsection (2),--
(a) in clause (b), for the word
"eighteen" the word "twenty-one" shall be substituted; and
(b) the proviso
shall be omitted.
